body:
I instinctively wrap my arms around myself, feeling the cool breeze from behind whisk away my hair. I can't breathe properly anymore—my throat tightens up, and beads of sweat form at my temples. My eyes close tightly as the weight of reality settles in. The sound of falling objects is replaced by distant rumbling—a car breaking down nearby or maybe even some fireworks exploding somewhere. 

The world feels like it's spinning around me now, but somehow I manage not to fall over.
full:
I instinctively wrap my arms around myself, feeling the cool breeze from behind whisk away my hair. I can't breathe properly anymore—my throat tightens up, and beads of sweat form at my temples. My eyes close tightly as the weight of reality settles in. The sound of falling objects is replaced by distant rumbling—a car breaking down nearby or maybe even some fireworks exploding somewhere. 

The world feels like it's spinning around me now, but somehow I manage not to fall over. Next: stay beside them and keep them steady.
